summary: Deterministic maintenance process for changing the blackhost skill.

process.action: Read SKILL.md, skill.json, schemas/maintain.json, schemas/eval.json, and every package manifest affected by the requested change.
process.passes_when: The agent can name the affected commands, modules, manifests, schemas, templates, generated local index artifacts, and assurance checks before editing.

process.action: Update runtime scripts first, preserving scripts/core/init.sh as the only public CLI entrypoint.
process.passes_when: Commands route through scripts/core/init.sh and package implementation functions follow blackhost_<package>_<command> naming.

process.action: Update VERSION and add a matching CHANGELOG.md row whenever a change intentionally alters skill behavior, public package capability, routing, schemas, templates, assurance, licensing, or generated-state contracts. Use semantic versioning with optional prerelease suffixes.
process.passes_when: VERSION exists, contains exactly one semantic version string such as 1.0.0-beta, CHANGELOG.md has one row for that version, and the row includes Version, User, LLM, and a summary of 240 characters or fewer.

process.action: Update manifests, skill.json, SKILL.md frontmatter and capability table, schemas/skill.openapi.yml tags/enums/paths/request schemas, templates, and local index metadata to match the runtime change.
process.passes_when: No public command, module filename, package name, safety rule, option, generated state artifact, or observable package tool exists in scripts without matching documentation, manifest metadata, and OpenAPI projection.

process.action: Update schemas/eval.json and assurance scripts when behavior, routing, packages, options, or maintenance rules change.
process.passes_when: assurance/eval.sh exercises the changed deterministic behavior directly or delegates to a focused assurance script.

process.action: Run assurance/eval.sh from the repository root.
process.passes_when: The script exits 0 and reports all checks as passing.

package_change_loop: Start from templates/manifest.json and templates/scripts/*.sh.
Create or update scripts/<package>/commons.sh for shared package helpers.
Create or update scripts/<package>/<command>.sh for command modules.
Expose command functions as blackhost_<package>_<command> and help functions as blackhost_<package>_<command>_help.
Add scripts/<package>/run.sh when the package normally owns local app execution or browser-opening workflows; otherwise record why run is intentionally absent in manifests/<package>.json notes.
Declare every public command in manifests/<package>.json.
Keep manifests/<package>.json formatted and complete, not compressed into a minimal single-line manifest.
Declare host and workspace mutation boundaries for every command.
Declare --dry-run semantics for commands that preview host or workspace mutation.
Declare --json support for command result output.

Update scripts/core/helpers/index.sh and templates/index.json when the package exposes observable local tools, versions, authentication state, or generated status that should appear in local/index.json and local/index.html.
Update templates/.gitignore when new generated per-user artifacts are added.
Update VERSION according to semantic versioning when behavior or public contracts change.
Update CHANGELOG.md with one row for the current VERSION, User, LLM, and a summary of 240 characters or fewer.
Update skill.json file references and summaries.
Update SKILL.md YAML frontmatter description, Mermaid package nodes, and capability/meta-prompt table.
Update manifests/core.json package list and routing package grammar.
Update schemas/skill.openapi.yml tags, manifest list, /manifests/{manifestName} enum, package operation paths, request schemas, x-blackhost manifest map, and x-blackhost filesystem map.
Update schemas/eval.json route smoke commands, static deterministic checks, local index assertions, and OpenAPI coverage assertions.
Update assurance/eval.sh and assurance/dry.sh so the new behavior can be checked without interpretation.
Run a routed command that regenerates local/index.json and local/index.html, then assert the package appears in both generated local artifacts when local index support is expected.

runtime: scripts/<package>/install.sh when host installation is supported
scripts/<package>/update.sh when host update is supported
scripts/<package>/run.sh when local app execution is supported
scripts/<package>/auth.sh when browser or account authentication is supported
contracts: schemas/skill.openapi.yml tag, manifest enum, operation paths, request schemas, x-blackhost manifests, and filesystem map
templates/index.json and scripts/core/helpers/index.sh when observable local status exists
assurance: schemas/eval.json local index package checks when applicable
assurance/dry.sh dry-run behavior checks for every supported mutating or app-run command

routing_contract.package_discovery: Package names are discovered from scripts/* directories excluding scripts/core.
routing_contract.command_discovery: Command names are discovered from scripts/<package>/*.sh excluding commons.sh.
routing_contract.manual_router_edits: Do not add package-specific case blocks to scripts/core/helpers/run.sh unless a command cannot follow the standard function naming contract.

output_contract.terminal: Default output is human-readable terminal messaging.
output_contract.json: --json appends one compact JSON result line with package, command, exit_code, status, dry_run, os, os_id, os_pretty, and arch.
output_contract.dry_run: Supported dry-run commands must print the detected host or workspace command path without executing it, including when tooling is already installed or currently missing.

local_index_contract.write_policy: Generated local index files are overwritten after each routed blackhost command.
local_index_contract.open_policy: Every routed command starts or reuses the local status server and triggers the system default browser for local/index.html unless BLACKHOST_OPEN_INDEX=false is set for automation.
local_index_contract.purpose: Allow agents to inspect recent local host state, last command output, and raw assurance/log.txt output before deciding whether to rerun checks.

assurance.log_policy: The log is overwritten on each direct dry.sh or eval.sh run.
